title: 第十三章 李雪的嘴好软，挑衅全网（求追读）
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“周播？”

潘岳明听到自己马上能平反的消息，先是控制不住地喜悦，那双有些沧桑的眼睛都重新亮了起来。

但是他很快冷静了下来。

周播可不一定是好消息。

现在市面上别说上星剧了，哪怕粗制滥造，野蛮生长的网剧也没有边拍边播的，除非是搞笑类的短剧。

要是稍有不慎，《白夜追凶》很有可能会因为这个原因翻车。

潘岳明不陌生边拍边播的周播剧模式。

好莱坞和南棒子都经常这么干。

可以通过舆情和收视调整剧情的播出制。

优势是延迟讨论周期，提升剧在社交平台热度，还能试播决定是否再投钱控制成本，有些平台制作方还能快速循环回款减轻现金流压力。

听着都是好处，但这模式没在华国流行起来是有原因的。

国内没有相应的商业模式，制片方全部采用一次性版权买断制，平台和片方没有深入利益绑定，这模式走不通。

而且国内项目核心都是资本，导演，投资人，演员轮番上阵作威作福。

就是没有编剧的话语权，周播剧的核心优势就不存在。

最主要的是，国内观众不一定适应这样的观影模式。

风险太大了。

“您确定吗？”

潘岳明第一次嗫嚅地对苏行舟发出质疑，或者说是劝阻。

他光是想想就害怕。

比起迟早会来的平反，潘岳明现在反而冷静下来，更希望剧能拍好。

要是《白夜追凶》能安稳拍好，让他再度爆红，什么时候沉冤昭雪反倒不着急了。

轻重缓急他分得清。

“放心潘哥，你只需要好好拍戏，静待花开就行了。”

苏行舟笑着拍了拍他的肩膀。

做出这样的选择，是他作为平台老板和制片人两个身份的双重考量。

p站的对赌协议仅剩一个月出头，他可以不赢下这个对赌，但是必须要在这段时间证明p站的价值，要不然他拍《白夜追凶》意义就没了。

而且这样还能缓解他拍摄需要的现金流。

从制片人身份的角度来说，边拍边播还真适合他现在的情况。

这是p站自制剧，他既是平台方也是自制方，回款又快又稳。

他是说一不二的制作人，整个剧组都是他说了算。

而且网剧还不用全集送审，不用像上星剧那样拿到完整发行许可证才能上线播出。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Weekly broadcast?"

When Pan Yueming heard the news that he would be rehabilitated soon, he could not control his joy at first, and his old eyes lit up again.

But he quickly calmed down.

Weekly broadcasts are not necessarily good news.

There are no star dramas on the market now. Even web dramas that are shoddily produced and wildly grown are not filmed and broadcast at the same time, unless it is a comedy short drama.

If you are not careful, "White Night" may overturn due to this reason.

Pan Yueming is no stranger to the weekly drama model of filming and broadcasting at the same time.

Hollywood and Southern Bangzi do this all the time.

The broadcast production of the plot can be adjusted through public opinion and ratings.

The advantage is that it delays the discussion cycle, increases the popularity of the drama on social platforms, and allows for trial broadcasts to decide whether to invest more money to control costs. Some platform producers can also quickly recycle payments to reduce cash flow pressure.

It all sounds good, but there is a reason why this model has not become popular in China.

There is no corresponding business model in China. All producers adopt a one-time copyright buyout system. There is no in-depth binding of interests between the platform and the film producers. This model will not work.

Moreover, the core of domestic projects is capital, with directors, investors, and actors taking turns to dominate.

Without the screenwriter's say, the core advantage of weekly dramas would not exist.

The most important thing is that domestic audiences may not be adaptable to this viewing mode.

The risk is too great.

"Are you sure?"

For the first time, Pan Yueming murmuringly questioned Su Xingzhou, or rather tried to dissuade him.

He was scared just thinking about it.

Rather than being redressed sooner or later, Pan Yueming has calmed down now and hopes the drama will be successful.

If "White Night" can be filmed safely and make him famous again, he will not be in a hurry to clear up his innocence.

He knows the priorities clearly.

"Don't worry, Brother Pan, you just need to film well and wait for the flowers to bloom."

Su Xingzhou smiled and patted his shoulder.

Making such a choice is a dual consideration of his identity as a platform owner and producer.

There is only a little more than a month left in the gambling agreement of Station P. He does not have to win the bet, but he must prove the value of Station P during this period, otherwise there will be no point in filming "White Night".

And this can also ease the cash flow he needs for filming.

From the perspective of a producer, filming and broadcasting at the same time is really suitable for his current situation.

This is a self-produced drama from Station P. He is both the platform and the self-producer, and the payment is fast and stable.

He is the one-stop producer, and he has the final say on the entire crew.

Moreover, online dramas do not need to submit the entire episode for review, nor do they need to obtain a complete distribution license before they can be broadcast online like star dramas.
